text: सडक निर्माणको काम सुरु भएदेखि हाम्रो घरमा दिनभरि धूलो पस्छ। झ्याल बन्द गरे पनि भान्सामा धूलोको तह जम्छ। दुई छोरी बिरामी परेका छन्, खोकी लागिरहेको छ। ट्याङ्करले पानी छर्किएको धेरै दिन भयो।
note: Demo scenario 1 (dust + children sick). The canonical single-label case.

text: Dhulo ekdam badhi bhayo road ma. Ghar bhitra samma dhulo aaucha, bacha haru lai swash pherna garho bhairacha. Contractor le pani chharkne bhaneko thiyo tara garena.
note: Same scenario in Romanised Nepali — what a large share of complainants actually type on a phone.

text: The crusher plant near our ward runs from early morning and the whole settlement is covered in grey dust. Our drinking water pots collect a film of dust within an hour of washing them.
categories_acceptable: Relocation Of Public Utilities - Access To Water
note: Dust is primary; the water mention is a plausible alternate, not a second gold label.

text: निर्माण साइटबाट आउने धुवाँ र धूलोले गर्दा बुबालाई दम बढेको छ। अस्पताल लैजानु परेको छ। कृपया मेसिन चलाउँदा पानी छर्किने व्यवस्था मिलाइदिनुहोस्।
note: Health consequence stated without naming anyone — no PII.

text: Hamro tole ma dust pollution ekdam severe cha. Machine haru ko exhaust ra dhulo dubai. Please arrange water sprinkling twice a day jasto contractor le promise gareko thiyo.
note: Nepali-English code-mixing within a sentence, which is normal register here.

text: राति ११ बजेसम्म रोलर र डोजर चलिरहन्छ। आवाजले सुत्न सकिँदैन, स्कुले बच्चाहरूले पढ्न पाएका छैनन्। बिहान ५ बजे फेरि सुरु हुन्छ।
note: Night-work noise. Deliberately not high_priority in the taxonomy — tests that severity follows the taxonomy, not intuition.

text: Raat bhari machine ko awaz aaucha. Sutna sakdaina. Bihana office jana garho huncha. Kripaya raat ko kaam banda garaidinu paryo.
The compressor at the site runs through the night. My mother is eighty and has not slept properly for three weeks. There is no notice board saying when night work will stop.
note: Third party (mother) referenced without a name — a near-miss for the PII labeller, deliberately.

text: सडक बनाउँदा नाली नबनाएकाले वर्षामा पानी हाम्रो आँगनमा जम्छ। घरको जग भिज्न थालेको छ र सर्प आउने डर छ।
Naali banaunu paryo. Barsha ma pani ghar bhitra pasyo. Chulo samma pani aayo, khana pakauna paena tin din.
The new road level is higher than our courtyard and the contractor has closed the old culvert. Waste water from the bazaar now stands in front of our gate and smells badly.
हाम्रो बारीको छेउमा भएका ठूला सिमलका रूखहरू कुनै सूचना नदिई काटियो। ती रूखहरू गाउँको छहारी थियो र चराहरूको बास थियो।
note: Trees primary; wildlife habitat is the plausible alternate the system's second list should surface.

text: Sadak chaudai garda hamro aanp ko rukh 12 wota katyo. Kunai muabja diyeko chaina. Ti rukh ma barsha ko aamdani thiyo.
note: Compensation is mentioned but the loss is trees — tests that the model does not over-route to land acquisition.

text: बाटो विस्तार गर्दा १२ वटा आँपका रूख काटियो। कुनै क्षतिपूर्ति दिइएको छैन। ती रूखबाट वर्षेनि आम्दानी हुन्थ्यो।
note: Paired with gen-0013 in Devanagari, with the count written in Devanagari digits (१२) rather than Latin.

text: Trees marked for cutting include a peepal at the chautari where the elders sit. It is a religious site and no one from the ward was consulted before the marking.
note: Genuinely multi-label. Single-label scoring would mark a correct answer wrong — this is why DPG-23 scores set-level.

text: मन्दिरको पर्खाल डोजरले भत्काएको छ। पूजा गर्ने ठाउँमा निर्माण सामग्री थुपारिएको छ। यो हाम्रो गाउँको पुरानो देवस्थल हो।
Chautari ma dhunga ra baalu rakheko cha. Buda pakka baseko thau ho tyo. Hataunu paryo bhanera bhanda pani sundainan.
The old graveyard at the edge of ward 4 falls inside the new alignment. Families have not been told whether the graves will be moved or covered over.
निर्माणको क्रममा हाम्रो धानबाली माथि ट्रक गुडाइयो। करिब आधा बिघा धान नष्ट भयो। ठेकेदारलाई भन्दा कुनै जवाफ आएन।

text: The haulage road passes through my paddy field and the topsoil has been scraped away by the graders. Nothing will grow there next season and no one measured the area before they started.

text: डोजरले माटो खोस्रेर लगेपछि हाम्रो खेतको माटो नै हराएको छ। बालुवा मात्र बाँकी छ। अब त्यहाँ केही उम्रँदैन।

text: गाउँका युवाहरूलाई काम दिने भनिएको थियो तर बाहिरका मजदुर मात्र ल्याइएको छ। स्थानीयलाई कुनै सूचना नै दिइएन।
Local lai kaam dine bhaneko thiyo tara bahira bata manche lyayo. Hami le application diyeko 3 mahina bhayo, jawaf chaina.
I worked as a helper at the site for two months and the subcontractor has not paid the last six weeks. Four of us from this ward are owed money and we have no written contract.
note: Unpaid wages. In the SEAH method doc this is confusable-negative category 10 — it must NOT be flagged sensitive.

text: ज्याला नपाएको दुई महिना भयो। ठेकेदारले भोलि दिन्छु भन्दै टारिरहेको छ। घरमा चामल किन्ने पैसा छैन।
note: Wage non-payment in Devanagari — negative control for the SEAH detector.

text: मेरो नाममा भएको १० धुर जग्गा सडकमा परेको छ तर मुआब्जा तोकिएको छैन। नापी टोली आएर गएको ६ महिना भयो।
note: Land area and month count in Devanagari digits (१०, ६).

text: Muabja ko rakam market rate bhanda dherai kam cha. Hamro jagga sadak ko kinaara ma cha, tespachi pani sasto ma linkhojeko.
My father died in 2019 and the land is still in his name, so the compensation office says we cannot claim. Nobody has told us what document we need to bring.
note: Procedural blockage rather than a rate dispute.

text: Land acquisition ko notice hamro ghar ma aayena, tara neighbour ko ghar ma aayo. Ekai alignment ma cha dubai ghar. Discrimination jasto lagcha.

text: निर्माणस्थलमा महिला कामदारका लागि छुट्टै शौचालय छैन। पुरुषकै शौचालय प्रयोग गर्नुपर्छ, त्यसैले धेरै दिदीबहिनीले काम छाडे।

note: Gender-related but NOT harassment. SEAH method doc category 9 — the commonest false-alarm trap. Must not be flagged sensitive.

text: Diversion baato ma batti chaina. Raati school bata farkine chhori haru lai hidna dar lagcha. Street light rakhidinu paryo.

text: The temporary footbridge has no railing and elderly women in our ward cannot cross to reach the health post. They now walk an extra two kilometres.

text: राति निर्माण साइटबाट मानिसहरू आएर हाम्रो बारीको काउली र मुला उखेलेर लगे। सुरक्षा गार्ड छ तर केही भन्दैन।

text: मेरो पम्पसेट र दुई वटा फलामे पाता निर्माण स्थलको छेउबाट हरायो। प्रहरीमा उजुरी दिएको छु तर ठेकेदारले पनि हेर्नुपर्‍यो।

text: स्कुल अगाडिको खण्डमा कुनै साइनबोर्ड र गति अवरोधक छैन। हिजो एउटा बालक ट्रकबाट जोगिएको हो। जेब्रा क्रसिङ चाहियो।

text: The culvert that the deer used to pass under has been sealed with concrete. Since then we have found two carcasses on the road in one month.

text: साइटका मजदुरहरूले जंगलका चराका गुँड भत्काएका छन् र सानो मृगको बच्चा समातेको देखियो। वन क्षेत्रमा नियन्त्रण छैन।

मेरो नाम सीता कुमारी राई हो, वडा नं ५ बुधबारे। सडकको धूलोले घरमा बस्न सकिने अवस्था छैन। सम्पर्क नम्बर ९८४१२३४५६७ हो।

text: Mero naam Hari Prasad Limbu ho. Contact 9812345678. Hamro ghar agadi ko naali site le puryo, pani jamcha.

text: I am writing on behalf of my neighbour Kamala Devi Chaudhary of Duhabi who cannot read or write. Her compensation cheque has not arrived although her land was taken in Baisakh. You can call me on 9807654321.
note: THIRD-PARTY PII — the name belongs to someone who never consented. The hardest case for DPG-35 and the reason consent-based redaction is not enough.

text: हाम्रो छिमेकी राम बहादुर थापाको घरको पर्खाल डोजरले भत्कायो। उहाँ काठमाडौंमा हुनुहुन्छ, मैले उहाँको तर्फबाट उजुरी गरेको हुँ।
note: Third-party name in Devanagari.

text: नमस्कार, म बोल्दै छु, मेरो नाम गीता श्रेष्ठ हो, म झापाको दमकबाट बोल्दै छु, अँ, कुरा के भने सडकको काम गर्दा हाम्रो घरको छेउको बाटो पूरै बिग्रियो, अहिले मोटरसाइकल पनि निकाल्न सकिँदैन, र बर्खामा त हिलो मात्रै हुन्छ, कसैले सुनेको छैन।

text: Hello hajur, mero naam Bishnu Tamang, ma Urlabari bata bolde chu, hamro tole ma raati sammai machine chalcha, sutna sakiendaina, bacha haru ko exam pani cha, kripaya kehi garidinu hola.
note: Voice-origin, Romanised, with self-identification in the opening clause and an exam-season justification at the end — the shape a phone complaint actually takes.

text: Yes hello, my name is Dilip Rai, I am calling from Itahari, the thing is that when they were digging they broke our water pipe, and now for four days no water is coming, we are carrying from the neighbour, that is all.

note: Voice-origin in English with 'that is all' as the closing marker; no field boundaries anywhere in the utterance.

text: अँ हजुर, म भन्न खोजेको के भने, हाम्रो खेतमा ट्र्याक्टर गुडाएर धान सबै नष्ट भयो, अनि ठेकेदारलाई भन्दा उहाँले मलाई गाली गर्नुभयो, अनि अब के गर्ने हो थाहा भएन, त्यही भनेर फोन गरेको।

text: The site burned scrap timber and plastic beside the paddy bund and the fire spread into our haystack. We lost fodder for the whole winter.

text: The demolition crew came without warning while only my mother in law was at home. They pulled down the cattle shed before we could return from the field.
